Ajit vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:35839) on 18 October,
2023

Author: Kuldeep Mathur Bench: Kuldeep Mathur [2023:RJ-JD:35839]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous 2nd Bail Application No. 11665/2023 Ajit S/o Laxman, Aged About 23 Years, R/o- Jambudi, Police Station Bichiwara, District Dungarpur (Rajasthan).
(Lodged In District Jail, Dungarpur)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr.Manoj Kumar Pareek.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Mr.Vikram Sharma, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR  ORDER 18/10/2023 This second application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with FIR No.218/2023 registered at Police Station Bichiwara, District Dungarpur, for offences under Sections 363, 344, 376 IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.

Learned counsel submitted that the prosecutrix remained in the company of the present petitioner out of her free will and volition for more than eight months and despite having ample opportunities, did not disclose the factum of she being subjected to sexual assault by the present petitioner to anyone.

Learned counsel submitted that as per prosecutrix, she was influenced by the petitioner, who allegedly used witchcraft tricks upon her and therefore, she could not inform anyone about the illegal acts of the petitioner.

Learned [2023:RJ-JD:35839] (2 of 3)
[CRLMB-11665/2023] counsel submitted that it is highly improbable that a mature girl remain under the petitioner's control/influence for about more than eight months and if she was subjected to sexual assault, she would not disclose the same to anyone, despite having ample opportunities.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner who is aged about 23 years is in judicial custody,
challan has been filed and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit Ajit vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:35839) on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194771901/
1 of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case so also the fact that the petitioner who is aged about 23 years is in judicial custody; the prosecutrix for about eight months did not disclose the factum of she being subjected to sexual assault to anyone; challan against the petitioner has already been filed, thus the investigation against him has already been completed; no recovery is due to be made from the petitioner, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the second bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner- Ajit S/o Laxman shall be enlarged on bail in connection with FIR No.218/2023 registered at Police Station Bichiwara, District Dungarpur, provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of [2023:RJ-JD:35839] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-11665/2023] Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to so.
It is however, made clear that findings recorded/observations made above are for limited purposes of adjudication of bail application.
The trial court shall not get prejudiced by the same.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J /tarun goyal/ Sr.No.40 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
